• Difficulty reading or recognising faces
• Sudden vision loss

Common retina disorders include diabetic retinopathy, retinal detachment, macular degeneration, macular holes, and retinal tears. Many of these conditions respond better when diagnosed and treated early.

featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Dear Mr. Baramatiwala,

Thank you for sharing your experience. We are genuinely sorry to hear about your concerns and wish we had the opportunity to assist you earlier.

LASIK is a very safe and advanced refractive procedure, but it is still a surgery — not a magic solution. As one of the high-volume LASIK centers, we have treated thousands of happy patients with excellent results. However, like with any surgery, a small number of patients may experience some symptoms afterwards. These are manageable issues, provided follow-ups and appropriate treatment are done.

Dry eye is also extremely common today — seen in over 50% of adults even without LASIK due to lifestyle and screen exposure (Yu et al., Cornea 2020; Stapleton et al., Prog Retin Eye Res 2017). Hence, it is not always caused by the procedure itself. However, some people link every possible eye problem they experience, to the surgery been done. LASIK related dry eyes usually does not last more than a year.

It is important to understand that LASIK corrects the existing number at the time of surgery but cannot prevent natural changes in the eye over the years. So it could be possible the number you have may be due to natural variation of the eye post surgery. Numbers that recur post surgery are treatable with flap lifts and enhancements, and we do these procedures routinely for patients, sometimes even 20 years after primary surgery.

Lastly, please understand that the cornea (on which we do LASIK surgery) is a biological tissue, and biological tissues in different individuals may behave differenetly. 

We also feel it is not fair to post a negative review without proper follow-up or giving us a chance to help, as many issues can be resolved easily once assessed. We sincerely invite you to visit us in Mumbai for an examination so that we can offer you the best possible solution.

featured_reviews.name: Rajesh Lalsingh Pawar
featured_reviews.review_text:
*Ah yes, “World-Famous” Dr. Rozmin Chagani – straight out of Mazgaon, yet apparently on par with every dentist from the USA to London. According to her, global dental standards are all the same, especially the one where cracking a patient’s teeth during a routine polishing is perfectly normal. How reassuring.

Let me paint a clearer picture: I walked into Chagani’s clinic for the first—and definitely the last—time, expecting dental care. What I got instead was a crash course in how not to treat patients. Her approach? Rude, dismissive, and wildly unprofessional. She doesn’t just lack listening skills—she actively avoids them, especially when she realizes she’s made a mistake. Instead of owning up or even acknowledging a patient’s concern, she shuts you down like you’ve walked into her clinic for charity work.

Now let’s talk about the actual treatment. My partner was told a root canal was necessary. Fair. But instead of doing the job properly, she shoved some cotton into the tooth and sealed it with what looked and felt like a low-budget school project. Then came my turn. A little polishing and scaling, she said. What I got was shredded enamel and a tongue that now comes with complimentary cuts every time I speak or eat. Delightful, really.

When I called to address this disaster, she treated me as if she’d paid me to visit her clinic. The tone? Aggressive. The professionalism? Nonexistent. Apparently, it’s outrageous for a patient to give feedback or question the damage caused. And her best line? “You must’ve never been to a dentist before.” Ma’am, I’m 37. Not exactly my first rodeo. And if I can afford to spend my hard-earned money at your clinic, I can just as easily go to one of the best dentists in Mumbai who actually treat patients with dignity.

In short: worst dental experience of my life. If you’re into being gaslit while your teeth are being butchered, by all means—go ahead. Otherwise, run. Even if someone pays me, I wouldn’t recommend Chagani’s Dental Clinic to my worst enemy.
